name: A22 v3.3 quiescent section Q(theta)
status: Future-return invariant domain; physical entry from training remains a proof obligation
parameter_semantics: All 15 constants per cell are fixed in time and chosen independently per port in their relative +/-1e-4 intervals. A, K, r, rm and the actuator/pump laws are fixed as in the supplied reference.
source_contract: Canonical pulses on source lane 0 only; first future pulse at or after T=1116; subsequent source gaps >=20.
section_rule: No incoming, outgoing, auxiliary or hidden pending physical current/event. Cached software history is interpreted through the same physical state, not dropped as an unproved numerical transformation.
full_tube_definition: For fixed theta, augment Q(theta) with physical one-pulse prefixes for age 0<=s<=20 and a source-age clock; allow the next source pulse only once age>=20. The certificate proves every such prefix is quiescent before 12.791 and returns to Q(theta); arbitrary additional idle time preserves Q(theta).
